# Frontguard

> Open-source frontend visual regression testing for web teams, with optional model-assisted review.

Frontguard is an open-source CLI with pre-release cloud components. The CLI is MIT-licensed and free forever. There is no generally available hosted cloud endpoint today.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://frontguard.dev/) — Product overview, install paths, comparison vs Percy / Chromatic / Argos
- [Pricing](https://frontguard.dev/pricing) — Free CLI ($0, MIT); hosted and team plans are pre-release design-partner concepts
- [Comparisons](https://frontguard.dev/comparisons) — Capability-by-capability vs Percy, Chromatic, BackstopJS, Lost Pixel, Argos, with sources
- [Changelog](https://frontguard.dev/changelog) — Notable releases, newest first (Keep a Changelog)
- [Brand](https://frontguard.dev/brand) — The amber shield mark, lockups, color tokens, typography, voice
- [Docs](https://frontguard.dev/docs) — Install, CLI, configuration, AI analysis, CI/CD, self-hosting (37 articles at `/docs/<slug>`)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ravidsrk/frontguard) — Source code, issues, contributing
- [npm: @frontguard/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@frontguard/cli) — CLI package
- [npm: @frontguard/playwright](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@frontguard/playwright) — Playwright plugin
- [Validation results](https://github.com/ravidsrk/frontguard/blob/main/validation/results-v0.2.md) — Real-repo pixel-only validation; AI accuracy remains pending

## For Agents

- [Agent task routing](https://frontguard.dev/agents.md) — Start here for MCP tools, cloud API routes, auth, limits, and safe task ordering
- [OpenAPI contract](https://frontguard.dev/openapi.json) — Machine-readable contract for the pre-release cloud API; there is no live default hosted endpoint yet
- [MCP discovery manifest](https://frontguard.dev/.well-known/mcp.json) — Discovery for `@frontguard/mcp`; point `FRONTGUARD_API_URL` at a verified deployment

## What Frontguard Does

- Configurable consensus — projects can opt into multiple captures per route; pixel comparison uses SSIM as a fallback
- Optional AI classification — screenshot evidence, basic route metadata, and optional accessibility findings go directly to the configured OpenAI or Anthropic provider
- Experimental fixes — CSS suggestions and sandbox verification are separate opt-ins; unverified suggestions remain labeled
- Plugin architecture — nine lifecycle hooks; built-ins for accessibility (axe-core), Figma compare, perf budgets, monitor, third-party-script drift
- CI-ready — generated workflows preserve JSON and HTML artifacts; source PR reporting remains pending external release validation
- Cloud source included — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 implementation is in the repository; hosted onboarding is pre-release and the Docker renderer is repository-source-only

## Install

```bash
npm install @frontguard/cli
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard init
```

App terminal (leave running; use your project's command, such as the example below, and wait for the generated `baseUrl`):

```bash
npm run dev
```

Frontguard terminal (uses the generated config):

```bash
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard doctor
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard update-baselines
git push origin frontguard-baselines # before CI comparisons
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard run
```

Playwright plugin:

```
npm install -D @frontguard/cli @frontguard/playwright
```

GitHub Action: external consumer smoke is pending, so no public copy-ready
Action workflow is published yet. Use the CLI flow above until the release
procedure in `docs/ops-actions.md` passes.
